supported.name: Razer DeathStalker V2 Pro

specs.Identity: VID 0x1532 · PID 0x0292, lighting on interface MI_03 of five
specs.Matrix: 6 × 22 = 132 cells, 106 of them under a key. A frame covers all 132: writing 106 leaves the rest on their previous colour
specs.Layout surveyed: French ISO. The device declares the grid; the key shapes are a hand transcription of it
specs.Firmware effects: Off, Spectrum Cycle, Wave — animated by the device, so they outlive the application
specs.Frames from the host: Measured at 13.1 ms a frame, a ceiling near 76 fps
specs.Brightness: Set per device, read back when the device opens
specs.Verified against: Firmware v1.5, surveyed 11–12 September 2026, every write read back

notes: Static and Breathing are in the protocol but not offered: where their colour sits in the read-back is not established, and rewriting something other than what is displayed is worse than offering nothing.
Reactive and Starlight are refused by this firmware.
Only the wired unit has been surveyed.
